title: One Eternity Later
blurb: For waits that exceed mortal patience, the show escalated its own running gag and never looked back. Where 'a few moments later' covers an ordinary delay, this card is reserved for the genuinely unreasonable: a passport office queue, the group project partner who has read your message and not replied, the friend who has been five minutes away for forty minutes. The narrator's weary delivery implies he aged noticeably during the interval. Essential transition material, and considerably funnier than simply cutting to the next scene.
origin: The exaggerated time card from SpongeBob SquarePants.
